notablePrerequisites: You control four or more creatures.
easyPrerequisites: Dual Casting and Umbral Mantle are attached to the same creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Battle Hymn by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Battle Hymn.
Resolve the copy of Battle Hymn, adding {R} for each creature you control
Activate the creature by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.
